name: .224 Cal-036gr Claw Hammer®

slowestTwist.raw: Minimum required twist rate is 1-16″ or faster

note: Recommended use: Small to medium game hunting where hide damage is a concern. The product page also says: "We designed the small caliber Claw Hammer® for hunters that are harvesting game animals and want to preserve the hide with as little damage as possible. This is the same design as our large caliber dangerous game, 100% weight retention bullets, with the cupped nose for great terminal performance."
